messages:
Noah: dropping a quick thread about where the trace export should live in the request drilldown. current mock puts a tiny export icon in the header, but Im worried about discoverability and a11y. screenshot: https://redwood.img/s/trace-drilldown-v2.png
Priya: header icon is easy to miss. my vote: put a small full label action in the right rail actions group  'Download JSON'  and keep a fallback icon in the header only for compact screen widths.
Sam: +1. also think about screen reader context: if the export sits in the rail we can include a short description in the rail region announcing what the download contains.
Ruth: small copy note: users often say "save trace" or "download logs". A clear label like "Download trace (JSON)" is explicit. shorter UI label could be "Download JSON" and expanded aria label for SR: "Download full trace as JSON for debugging".
Omar: technical constraints: some traces are huge. backend should return a streamed response and we should show progress UI. for the UX, I'd rather an inline progress row in the rail than a blocking modal.
Noah: agree on inline progress. proposal: right-rail primary button "Download JSON" -> on click it disables, shows small progress bar + text "Preparing download (streaming)", final link appears as "Save file". header icon becomes aria-hidden to SRs by default.
Priya: keyboard flow: ensure tab order goes Breadcrumbs -> Main controls -> Right rail actions -> Content. Export must not be first in tab order. add visible focus ring and larger hit target.
Sam: for SR: use aria-live polite region for status updates (e.g., "Preparing download, 30% streamed"). also when file is ready announce "Trace download ready" with a link that SR users can activate.
Ruth: small accessibility color nit: the export button currently uses our token blue-300 on white; on small text that is 3.1:1. bump to blue-600 or add a filled button variant.
Omar: API suggestion snippet:
```js
// stream to client
fetch('/api/traces/xyz/download')
  .then(res => {
    const reader = res.body.getReader();
    // stream to file writer or blob
  })
```
Keep endpoint idempotent and return Content-Disposition header.
Noah: analytics: record export_initiated, export_completed, export_failed, export_size_bytes, export_time_ms. useful for A/B.
Priya: A/B idea: test rail action vs header icon vs command-palette action. metric: export success within 10s and keyboard discoverability. run for 2 weeks.
Sam: for copy variants: A: "Download JSON" B: "Download trace" C: "Export session JSON". I'll mock all three in figma quick.
Ruth: QA-Bot: accessibility checklist added to thread. items: focus order, ARIA labels, contrast >=4.5:1 for icon-only controls, announce states.
Omar: rollout: behind a feature flag and telemetry enabled. engineers can ship rail action first and keep header icon as visual affordance.
Noah: action items: Sam -> figma variants, Ruth -> accessibility checklist + contrast tokens, Omar -> streaming API spec + headers, Priya -> A/B plan and ticket. I'll collate and schedule review next Tues. Thanks :sparkles:
QA-Bot: created ticket design-4520 (Trace export placement + streaming + a11y). assigned: Sam, Ruth, Omar, Priya.
